# blendops-scene-plan

Purpose: Plan character portraits, environment shots, and interior scenes from a locked brief, with stage gates and evidence expectations.

Metadata: Contract `v2.0.0` | Category `scene-planners` | Role `character-environment-and-interior-scene-planner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- The brief is a character portrait or bust.
- The brief is an environment, landscape, or outdoor shot.
- The brief is an interior room or architectural scene.
- Trigger phrases: "portrait of", "character looking at the camera", "headshot", "hero shot of [person / mascot / creature]", "establishing shot of", "wide shot of", "city / forest / desert / ocean scene", "set the scene", "interior of", "living room scene", "office showcase", "hotel lobby", "kitchen showroom"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- product hero scenes → use `blendops-product-shot` (`references/skill-blendops-product-shot.md`; use blendops-product-shot)
- multi-character ensemble (this skill is single-subject) → use `blendops-brief` (`references/skill-blendops-brief.md`; this skill is single-subject)
- product hero → use `blendops-product-shot` (`references/skill-blendops-product-shot.md`; use blendops-product-shot)
- single hero product → use `blendops-product-shot` (`references/skill-blendops-product-shot.md`; use blendops-product-shot)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `locked_3d_brief` (`object`): Locked 3D brief specifying character subject, expression/pose, and framing intent
- Required input `character_asset_posture` (`object`): Available character model/rig status and material readiness from asset discovery
- Optional input `turntable_or_still_preference` (`string`): Whether the deliverable is a portrait still, bust turntable, or full-body pose
- Optional input `atmosphere_and_time_of_day` (`object`): Target time of day, weather condition, and atmospheric haze/fog parameters
- Optional input `asset_discovery_constraints` (`object`): Available environment kitbash or terrain assets from blendops-assets
- Optional input `room_dimensions_and_openings` (`object`): Architectural envelope, window/door openings, and primary furniture anchor zones
- Optional input `sourced_furniture_and_finish_assets` (`array`): Available furniture and architectural material assets from blendops-assets
- Output contract: `character_staging_and_pose_plan`, `eyeline_and_portrait_camera_anchors`, `skin_hair_rim_lighting_hooks`, `foreground_midground_background_layer_plan`, `sun_sky_atmosphere_specification`, `horizon_and_scale_anchor_plan`, `interior_zone_and_circulation_plan`, `window_portal_and_fixture_lighting_plan`, `two_point_vertical_camera_constraints` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).
